errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns 31% (9.8 tn) to 'Other services' in the 'Turnover' chart. The figure shows this value belongs to 'Industry' (yellow).

The description omits the overall purpose of the chart, which is to show the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021 as a percentage of the total economy.
The description does not explicitly mention that the absolute values are in millions (mln) and trillions (tn), as indicated in the figure.
